items.item: Create a hello.txt file in the project root
items.description: Create a file called hello.txt in /root/t1d/ with the content "Hello from subagent test". Verify the file exists after creation.

items.item: List all Python files in the app directory
items.description: Run `find app -name "*.py" | sort` and report the full list of Python files in the app directory.

items.item: Count lines of code in the project
items.description: Run `find . -name "*.py" -not -path "./venv/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | xargs wc -l` and report the total line count.

items.item: Create a goodbye.txt file in the project root
items.description: Create a file called goodbye.txt in /root/t1d/ with the content "Goodbye from subagent test". Verify the file exists after creation.

items.item: List all test files in the tests directory
items.description: Run `find /root/t1d/tests -name "*.py" | sort` and report the full list of test files.

items.item: Count total number of files in the project
items.description: Run `find /root/t1d -not -path "./venv/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./.pi/*" -type f | wc -l` and report the total file count.

items.item: Show the last 10 commits in the repo
items.description: Run `git -C /root/t1d log --oneline -10` and report the output.

items.item: Create a timestamp file with current date
items.description: Run `date` to get the current timestamp, then create /root/t1d/timestamp.txt with that value. Verify the file.

items.item: Create a notes.txt file with a short message
items.description: Create `/root/t1d/notes.txt` with content "Notes from subagent test run". Verify the file exists.

items.item: List all .json files in the project
items.description: Run `find /root/t1d -name "*.json" -not -path "./venv/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" | sort` and report the full list.

items.item: Count lines of code in the tests directory
items.description: Run `find /root/t1d/tests -name "*.py" | xargs wc -l` and report the total line count.
Create `/root/t1d/README_extra.md` with a short markdown heading and one paragraph. Verify the file.

items.item: Show disk usage of the project
items.description: Run `du -sh /root/t1d/* | sort -rh | head -10` and report the output.

items.item: Set up pre-commit hooks for the frontend
items.description: Configure Husky + lint-staged for the frontend directory.
items.activeForm: Setting up pre-commit hooks with Husky + lint-staged

items.item: Audit the entire frontend for unused components
items.description: Scan the frontend/src directory and identify components/pages/hooks that are not imported or used anywhere. This audit will produce a list of candidates for cleanup.

items.item: Review all API endpoints for missing validation
items.description: Review every endpoint in app/api/ and identify which ones are missing input validation, error handling, or auth guards. This review will produce a list of endpoints needing fixes.
